actions.text: Store status (kb, 2026-11-24) of nonlinear stability results for FLRW-type cosmologies under Einstein-Vlasov. Future stability is proven (i) with a positive cosmological constant (Ringstrom; review arXiv:1106.1367 article.tex L2192-2193, L2215-2217; surface-symmetric case arXiv:1402.7085 L50); (ii) for the Milne model, a vacuum k = -1 FLRW with linear expansion, with massive Vlasov matter, stated as the first Einstein-Vlasov stability result in 3+1 dimensions with vanishing cosmological constant in the cosmological case (arXiv:1709.00267 main.tex L363, L392-393), also with charged matter (arXiv:2012.14241 L329-330); (iii) for massless Vlasov matter, i.e. radiation-like decelerated expansion: homogeneous FLRW on R^3 against compactly supported spherically symmetric perturbations (arXiv:2306.17774 L49) and Bianchi I data isotropizing to a radiative Einstein-de Sitter model (arXiv:1904.13290 L333). Toward the past, stable Big Bang formation holds for near-FLRW Einstein-scalar-field-Vlasov data (arXiv:2402.08544 L152). For the matter-dominated Einstein-de Sitter background the store has fluid results only: linearly unstable with dust, nonlinearly stable for a polytropic fluid with index n > 3 on T^3 (arXiv:2607.09326 main.tex L96, L141; numerical Gowdy evidence arXiv:2606.16879 L43); arXiv:2607.09326 names other matter models only as an outlook (L311). No paper in the store proves or tests nonlinear stability of a matter-dominated (massive particles, Lambda = 0) FLRW under Einstein-Vlasov [VERIFIED for the store by search, package claims3; absence from the literature is not claimed].
